MESSAGE: Leave it to me! I'll be back with those dragon balls!
Wow that was a lot of work... I'm glad that's over! I wonder what Vegeta is up to....
Aw man again! He really needs to stop sneaking off like that. Thanks Bulma, I'll see you around!
Alright lets go! I owe one to King Kai, big time! I won't let you down this time King Kai!!
Frieza? What are you doing here.. I don't see any traps... wait a minute, do you have the Dragon Balls?
Really? That's gotta be one tough saiyan to overthrow you Frieza. Hey why do you have the Dragon Balls, anyways?
oh so that's what this is all about! You know, you didn't have to go through all that trouble just to fight me Frieza. But if that's how it's gonna be then I guess we'll have to see if you're right!!
You're such a fool goku, you fell right into my trap!
Yes you fool! There are rumors that one day a Saiyan could rise to overthrow me. Such a pity how one could be so ignorant!!
You idiot! Just shut up and fight me already! I will not tolerate such rumors of a Saiyan rising above me so now I must eliminate all Saiyans, starting with you!
Okay, stop right here. It's telling me they are right above us, but I don't see anything. Maybe you can take a look.
Hey Goku. Unfortunately, you're too late. He left to train with Lord Beerus yesterday.
Wait! Before you go, I had a favour to ask of you...my Super Dragon Radar is picking up a strong signal of all 7 Dragon Balls! If you can help me locate them, I'll let you have one wish!
